test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Spot the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the options given.

All the panel members has been invited for the monthly meeting.

options.text: All the panel members was invited for the monthly meeting.
All the panel members been invited for the monthly meeting.
All the panel members have been invited for the monthly meeting.
All the panel members would have being invited for the monthly meeting.

solution:
The correct answer is **"All the panel members have been invited for the monthly meeting."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given question has been started with the **plural form** of the **"panel members"**.
 
• If the subject is a **plural noun or plural pronoun**, use have.
 
• So the **third option** is the correct one.

The correct sentence is **All the panel members have been invited for the monthly meeting**.
